sentences.l2: 每年黄金周,国内热门景区几乎都在上演同一场"人潮大戏"。
sentences.l1: Every year during Golden Week, the popular scenic spots in China are almost all staging the same "big show of crowds".

sentences.l2: 天还没亮,山门外的队伍已蜿蜒数里,游客攥着手机反复刷新页面,唯恐门票预约名额在几分钟内被抢空。
sentences.l1: Before dawn, the queue outside the mountain gate has already wound for several li, and tourists clutch their phones and refresh the page repeatedly, fearing that the ticket reservation slots will be snatched up within a few minutes.

sentences.l2: 进了景区,所谓游览更像被人流推着前行:观景台上摩肩接踵,拍一张照要排半天队,人山人海,举步维艰。
sentences.l1: Once inside the scenic area, so-called sightseeing is more like being pushed forward by the crowd: the viewing platform is shoulder to shoulder, taking a single photo means queuing for half a day, a sea of people, every step difficult.

sentences.l2: 于是不少人开始反思自己的出行方式。
sentences.l1: So quite a few people begin to reflect on their way of traveling.

sentences.l2: 有人把假期拆成两段,错峰前往;有人放弃网红景点,转向名气不大却风景清幽的小城与村落。
sentences.l1: Some split the holiday into two parts and go at off-peak times; some give up internet-famous attractions and turn to small towns and villages that are not very famous but have quiet, beautiful scenery.

sentences.l2: 旅游攻略也随之更新,不再一味罗列"必去打卡地",而是提醒读者留意限流公告与天气变化。
sentences.l1: Travel guides have been updated accordingly, no longer simply listing "must-visit check-in spots", but reminding readers to pay attention to crowd-limiting announcements and weather changes.

sentences.l2: 毕竟旅行的意义在于放松身心、开阔眼界,而非在拥挤中耗尽体力与耐心。
sentences.l1: After all, the meaning of travel lies in relaxing the body and mind and broadening the horizons, not in exhausting one's strength and patience in crowds.

sentences.l2: 学会与人群保持距离,或许才是当代旅行者最该补上的一课。
sentences.l1: Learning to keep a distance from crowds may well be the lesson that contemporary travelers most need to make up.
